# telnyx_ai_tools (Data Source)

Lists ai tools, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_tool`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_ai_tools" "webhooks" {
  filter_type = "webhook"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_type` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_tools` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_tools))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_tools`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `timeout_ms` (Number)
- `tool_definition` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `type` (String)
